text: No, I don't think so. University is essential for some careers, like medicine or law, but plenty of well-paid jobs need practical training rather than a degree — electricians and programmers are good examples. The problem is that a degree is often seen as the only respectable path, so young people go just because everyone else does and end up in jobs unrelated to their studies.

tips.en: Electricians and programmers are good examples backs up the point at once.
tips.kk: Electricians and programmers are good examples — дәлел бірден нақтыланған.
tips.ru: Electricians and programmers are good examples — довод сразу подкреплён.
tips.example: electricians and programmers are good examples

tips.en: The only respectable path explains why everyone still goes to university.
tips.kk: The only respectable path — бәрі неге бәрібір ЖОО-ға баратынын түсіндіресіз.
tips.ru: The only respectable path — объясняете, почему все всё равно идут в вуз.

questions.question: Is it necessary for everyone to go to university?

text: The obvious one is the quality of education at some foreign universities, but I think the personal benefits are just as important. Living alone in another country forces you to become independent very quickly — you manage your own money, deal with bureaucracy and solve problems without your family nearby. You also build an international network of friends, which can open doors later in your career.

tips.en: The personal benefits are just as important moves from the obvious to the interesting.
tips.kk: The personal benefits are just as important — айқыннан қызықтыраққа көшу.
tips.ru: The personal benefits are just as important — от очевидного к более интересному.
tips.example: the personal benefits are just as important

tips.en: Managing money and dealing with bureaucracy show independence in action.
tips.kk: You manage your own money, deal with bureaucracy — «дербестік» іспен көрсетілген.
tips.ru: You manage your own money, deal with bureaucracy — «самостоятельность» показана делом.
tips.example: you manage your own money, deal with bureaucracy

questions.question: What are the advantages of studying abroad?

text: In principle, I think it should be, at least for students with good results. Free education means talented people from poorer families get the same chances as wealthy ones, and the whole country benefits from having more qualified specialists. The challenge is funding. In practice, a system of state grants for the best applicants, like the one we have in Kazakhstan, seems like a sensible compromise.

tips.en: In principle and In practice are a pair of linkers for the ideal and the reality.
tips.kk: In principle … In practice — мұрат пен шындыққа арналған байланыстырушы сөз жұбы.
tips.ru: In principle … In practice — пара связок для идеала и реальности.

tips.en: Like the one we have in Kazakhstan is a convincing example from your own country.
tips.kk: Like the one we have in Kazakhstan — өз еліңізден мысал нандырады.
tips.ru: Like the one we have in Kazakhstan — пример из своей страны убеждает.
tips.example: like the one we have in Kazakhstan

questions.followUp: Who should pay for it then?
questions.question: Should university education be free?

text: I'd like to see a better balance. At the moment, a lot of graduates know the theory very well but have never applied it, so employers have to train them almost from scratch. Internships and real projects with companies should be a compulsory part of every degree. Even so, theory still matters, because it's what allows people to adapt when practical methods change.

tips.en: I'd like to see a better balance avoids choosing an extreme.
tips.kk: I'd like to see a better balance — шектен тыс жақты таңдамайсыз.
tips.ru: I'd like to see a better balance — вы не выбираете крайность.
tips.example: I'd like to see a better balance

tips.en: Should be a compulsory part of every degree is a measure, not just a wish.
tips.kk: Should be a compulsory part of every degree — тілек емес, нақты шара.
tips.ru: Should be a compulsory part of every degree — мера, а не пожелание.
tips.example: should be a compulsory part of every degree

questions.question: Should universities focus more on practical skills than on theory?

text: I think things are already moving in that direction. Many top universities now offer online programmes with the same exams and the same diploma, and employers care more about skills than about where you studied. Still, there's a certain prestige attached to being on campus, and some fields, like medicine, will always need hands-on training, so traditional degrees won't disappear.

tips.en: Already moving in that direction bases the prediction on what is already happening.
tips.kk: Already moving in that direction — болжам қазірдің өзінде болып жатқан нәрсеге сүйенеді.
tips.ru: Already moving in that direction — прогноз опирается на то, что уже происходит.
tips.example: things are already moving in that direction

tips.en: Some fields, like medicine shows where online study will not work.
tips.kk: Some fields, like medicine — мысал онлайн оқу қай жерде жүрмейтінін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Some fields, like medicine — пример показывает, где онлайн не сработает.
tips.example: some fields, like medicine, will always need hands-on training
